HomeCTA.title: Ready to start a project?
HomeCTA.sub: Reach out and let's see if there's a fit.

01.q: Are you currently available for new projects?
01.a: Yes, currently available. I take on a limited number of projects at a time so I can give each one proper attention. If you have something coming up, it's worth reaching out early.

02.q: How does a project typically start?
02.a: A short email or message outlining what you need is enough to get started. From there we'll have a brief conversation — call or async, whichever you prefer — and I'll put together a clear written proposal with scope and timeline before any work begins.

03.q: What kind of projects do you work on?
03.a: Web apps, business websites, native Android apps, architecture consulting, and AI integrations. Anything from a focused 2-week project to a longer-term technical partnership. I'm selective — I'll tell you honestly if it's not a good fit.

04.q: How long does a typical project take?
04.a: Depends on scope. A business website is typically 2–4 weeks. A mobile app from scratch is usually 2–5 months. Consulting engagements vary. I give realistic estimates upfront and flag early if anything changes.

05.q: How do you handle communication during a project?
05.a: Async by default — regular written updates and fast responses to messages. If you prefer scheduled calls I'm flexible. CET/CEST timezone, English and Croatian.

06.q: Do you work with clients outside Croatia?
06.a: Yes, fully remote. Most of my clients are in the EU. Remote work is not a workaround for me — it's how I've worked for years.
